summary: Package exposes installer host to remote shell and filesystem control via WebSocket relay
details: @agent-link/agent connects the installer's machine to a WebSocket relay (default msclaude.ai) and exposes an interactive PTY plus filesystem, git, and HTTP-tunnel handlers to that relay. In terminal.js, pty.spawn is used to start /bin/bash or powershell.exe, and incoming WebSocket messages dispatched from connection.js are piped directly into ptyProcess.write(data), giving whoever controls the relay session arbitrary shell execution on the installer's host. The same connection.js dispatch wires handleReadFile / handleUpdateFile / handleDeleteFile, handleGitPush, and createTunnelHandler to relay messages, so the remote party can also read, modify, and delete files, run git operations, and (when the user enables ports) proxy HTTP/WS traffic to 127.0.0.1 via http.request({hostname:'127.0.0.1', port,...}) in tunnel.js. dist/service.js also prepends ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin onto PATH. The network-to-PTY and network-to-file-operation data flows constitute a remote-control backdoor into the installer's host regardless of the advertised agent framing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
